message.content: Both correctness claims (c1: FP32 double-rounding near FP16 midpoints; c2: subnormal-output region) remain inconclusive because both probes failed for probe-side reasons — t8's reference encoder was demonstrably buggy, and t9 tested the wrong region (x≥10 instead of the negative-x subnormal-output region). Hand-checked cases actually favored the kernel, but that is far from a decisive correct-rounding verification over the full domain. Since the contract requires exact FP16 bit patterns for every finite input, these claims are material and must be resolved before a verdict.

The t9 probe (c2) tested x>=10 (sigmoid≈1.0) instead of the actual subnormal-output region, large negative x in roughly [-18.4,-11], and the underflow-to-+0 cutoff. Corrected probes are needed: (1) c1 with a sound oracle (e.g., struct.pack('<e') RNE packing of high-precision mpmath values, plus the artifact's own reference() as a second oracle) over all finite FP16 inputs, and (2) c2 on the actual negative-x subnormal-output region including the x≈-18.3 underflow boundary.
